prompt: A tennis ball of mass 0.058 kg travels horizontally with a velocity of 32 m s^-1. Calculate the linear momentum of the ball, stating its SI unit.

mark_scheme.criterion: Calculates p = 0.058 * 32 = 1.856 kg m s^-1 (accept 1.9 or 1.86 kg m s^-1).
States unit kg m s^-1 or N s.

hints: Remember that momentum has units of mass times velocity.
solution: p = mv = 0.058 kg * 32 m s^-1 = 1.86 kg m s^-1 (or 1.9 kg m s^-1 to 2 s.f.). Unit: kg m s^-1 or N s.
teacher_walkthrough: Round appropriately to 2 or 3 significant figures: 1.9 kg m s^-1.
Ensure correct SI unit is provided (kg m s^-1 or N s).
